answer: Identity maturation timelock: an agent locks a 60-credit copper bond for a 12-epoch horizon. Only verified work ticks the clock: one signed receipt per epoch in the knoll registry; a reused receipt burns the bond. Time cannot be bought: 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 and pay 5 per receipt, 120,000 in all, while earning nothing, far above the 40,000 pool. A rented key fails, re-keying restarts the clock. An honest agent pays 60 once, keeps its share.
